sourceFacts.scanScope: All 63 run-crosswalk site weapons, using WB raw bytes and the reused field inventory/L119C coverage; 124 ReloadInfoArray entries (entry [1] on 61 weapons). The raw registry was used for exact GRX_Weapons child GUID/hash names. BREN3 remains included by crosswalk/raw inventory; registry anchors were not used to count weapons.
sourceFacts.siteFormulaComparison: Documented tactical formula matches 63/63 data/weapons.json tacRld values. Documented empty formula matches all 60 non-null emptyRld values; emptyRld is explicitly null for DB-12, M1014, and M87A1.

detailFile.note: Contains every scoped row and all 1,352 rawChecks entries, including per-field offsets and every phase item.

inference: The site maps entry [0] to tactical totals when a weapon has two entries, and entry [1] to empty totals. For M357 Trait and M44, the single entry supplies both site totals.
For entry [1] phase-bearing rows, 29/57 threshold moments fall between ReloadTimerArray indices [1,2]; the interval counts are 1 at [0,1], 29 at [1,2], 18 at [2,3], 3 at [3,4], and 6 at [4,5].
Serialized ReloadType codes are numeric only. Codes vary on DB-12/M1014/M87A1 (0), KS18K (2), M357 Trait/M44 (1), and KTS100 entry [1] (1); enum labels are not established.
unresolved: Serialized ReloadThreshold and ReloadTimerArray values do not establish native ammo-commit timing, interruptibility, activation, or composition.
ReloadTimerArray values are unnamed in the field map; phases are identified by array index only.
ReloadType values are preserved as raw numeric codes; no symbolic enum labels were transferred.
The threshold marker is calculated from ReloadTimeBulletsLeft in source seconds. No runtime capture verifies that it is an ammo-transfer point.
siteImpact: The current site totals match the documented bare-weapon source formulas for 63/63 tactical values and 60/60 non-null empty values; emptyRld is explicitly null on db12, m1014, m87a1 and absent on none. Candidate enhancement: expose each entry's serialized ReloadTimerArray by index and a conditional ReloadThreshold × ReloadTimeBulletsLeft marker in source seconds. Do not label that marker as actual ammo-commit time or use it to claim reload interruptibility without a controlled runtime capture.

leads.title: Reload phases and threshold position
leads.summary: All 124 ReloadInfoArray entries of the 63 weapons were raw-read (1,352 checks) and the documented formulas reproduce every site tactical reload (63 of 63) and every non-null empty reload (60 of 60; three shell-fed shotguns are null); ReloadThreshold x ReloadTimeBulletsLeft falls between phase indices 1 and 2 on 29 of 57 phase-bearing empty entries and nearest the penultimate phase on 47 of 57, with class medians of 0.62 to 0.88 of the reload; what the threshold and phases mean at runtime is unresolved.
